tuples.episode_object: a limestone battle relief with chariot teams cut into a pylon face

tuples.mechanism: horses bought from the desert trade cannot be bred locally, so cavalry depends on imports
tuples.evidence_lens: stirrup types from raid sites matched to workshops on the northern trade routes

tuples.episode_object: a scholar's teaching licence written on the flyleaf of a legal text
tuples.time_place_scope: the Sankore quarter of Timbuktu, the 1490s
tuples.mechanism: a licence naming a chain of teachers gives a legal opinion weight no decree can supply
tuples.evidence_lens: licence chains from surviving manuscripts compared for who taught whom

tuples.episode_object: a market price notice recording a sudden drop in the gold rate
tuples.time_place_scope: Cairo and the pilgrimage road through Egypt, 1324
tuples.mechanism: one very large gold disbursement in a market depresses its price for years afterward
tuples.evidence_lens: Egyptian price notices from the 1320s compared with the decade before the pilgrimage

tuples.episode_object: a muster roll listing arquebusiers and their powder allowance
tuples.time_place_scope: Marrakesh, the Saadian capital, the 1580s
tuples.mechanism: firearms need imported powder, so a gunpowder army is only as far-ranging as its supply
tuples.evidence_lens: the muster roll's powder allowance compared with consumption in the campaign accounts

tuples.episode_object: a desert guide's payment receipt for leading a column to the wells
tuples.time_place_scope: the Taghaza to Taodeni crossing of the Sahara, 1590 to 1591
tuples.mechanism: an army crossing waterless country loses men to thirst before it meets any enemy
tuples.evidence_lens: receipt stage names set against the losses reported by chroniclers on either side

tuples.episode_object: a matchlock barrel and a lance head from one battlefield surface
tuples.time_place_scope: Tondibi, on the plain north of Gao, 1591
tuples.mechanism: massed handguns beat cavalry by breaking the charge before contact, not by killing more
tuples.evidence_lens: weapon finds mapped by position and compared with the two chronicle battle accounts

tuples.episode_object: a river garrison's tribute demand written on a slip of paper
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dendi reaches of the lower Niger, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: a defeated dynasty holding a river's far reaches taxes the traffic its conqueror wants
tuples.evidence_lens: the demand's rates compared with the tolls the northern garrisons recorded upstream

tuples.episode_object: a factory ledger of horses traded for captives at a coastal fort
tuples.time_place_scope: Arguin island and the Atlantic edge of the western Sahara, the 1450s
tuples.mechanism: a sea route offering horses at the shore undercuts the desert crossing that carried them
tuples.evidence_lens: coastal ledger horse prices set beside inland market prices in matching years

tuples.episode_object: a customs book from a coastal trade castle recording inland gold
tuples.time_place_scope: Elmina on the Guinea coast, the 1480s
tuples.mechanism: gold reaching the sea instead of the desert moves a whole tax base away from the interior
tuples.evidence_lens: coastal gold receipts compared with the volumes still crossing the northern routes

tuples.episode_object: a royal tomb marker cut with a name and a date
tuples.time_place_scope: Kukiya, downriver from Gao on the Niger, the fifteenth century
tuples.mechanism: burying rulers at an older site keeps a new capital's claim tied to an ancestral seat
tuples.evidence_lens: tomb marker dates compared with the regnal lists given in the two local chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a city chronicle's entry on a levy of horses and mail shirts
tuples.time_place_scope: Kano and the Hausa lands east of the Niger, the 1510s
tuples.mechanism: a tributary city pays in war material, so tribute directly funds the next campaign
tuples.evidence_lens: levy entries compared with the campaign seasons recorded in the collector's own annals

tuples.episode_object: a salt caravan's toll tally kept at an oasis gate
tuples.time_place_scope: Agades and the mountains of the central Sahel, the 1500s
tuples.mechanism: controlling an oasis gate converts a trade route into a predictable annual income
tuples.evidence_lens: gate tallies compared with arrival counts recorded at the southern terminus

tuples.episode_object: a cliff granary's sealed jar and the millet stored inside it
tuples.time_place_scope: the Bandiagara escarpment above the flood plain, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: storing grain in cliffs beyond reach of cavalry is what lets a people refuse tribute
tuples.evidence_lens: granary capacity measured against the size of the communities that used them

tuples.episode_object: a chancery register of land grants confirmed to new officeholders
tuples.time_place_scope: the chancery of the Timbuktu pashalik, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: confirming old land grants to new officials buys consent without paying for it
tuples.evidence_lens: the register's grant list compared with the endowment deeds it quietly replaced

coverage_profiles.subject: the Ming campaigns against the Mongols and the Tumu crisis

tuples.episode_object: a horse trade tally from a frontier market
tuples.time_place_scope: the border market at Datong, the 1440s
tuples.mechanism: capping how many horses a neighbour may sell turns a trade rule into a diplomatic weapon
tuples.evidence_lens: market tallies before and after the quota change compared with the mission sizes

tuples.episode_object: a tribute mission register listing envoy numbers and gifts

tuples.mechanism: paying every envoy in a party rewards inflating the headcount until the host refuses

tuples.episode_object: a grain transport receipt from a canal barge convoy

tuples.mechanism: moving southern grain north by water decides how large a frontier garrison can be fed
tuples.evidence_lens: barge receipts compared with the garrison ration rolls they were meant to supply

tuples.episode_object: a campaign supply memorial arguing about cart numbers
tuples.time_place_scope: the steppe north of the Kerulen river, the 1410s
tuples.mechanism: an army that must carry its own grain can only advance as far as its carts allow
tuples.evidence_lens: cart counts in the memorial measured against the distance the column actually reached

tuples.episode_object: a beacon tower duty roster kept by a frontier garrison
tuples.time_place_scope: the signal line west of Xuanfu, the 1440s
tuples.mechanism: smoke counts agreed in advance let one tower report enemy strength, not just presence
tuples.evidence_lens: roster signal codes compared with the alarm reports that reached the capital

tuples.episode_object: a marching order fixing the route of an imperial column
tuples.time_place_scope: the road from Beijing toward Datong, the seventh month of 1449
tuples.mechanism: a decision to reverse a route midway strands a column without prepared water stops
tuples.evidence_lens: the ordered route compared with the supply depots that had actually been stocked

tuples.episode_object: a loss and captive report sent to the ministry
tuples.time_place_scope: the post station at Tumu, 1449
tuples.mechanism: losing a court and its guard in one place removes the men who normally sign orders
tuples.evidence_lens: the report's figures set beside the later official histories, which differ widely

tuples.episode_object: an emperor's personal seal listed in a captor's inventory
tuples.time_place_scope: the Oirat camps beyond the frontier, 1449 and 1450
tuples.mechanism: holding a captured ruler turns a battlefield result into a bargaining position
tuples.evidence_lens: ransom demands recorded by both courts compared for what was actually asked

tuples.episode_object: an accession edict naming a new reign title
tuples.time_place_scope: the palace in Beijing, the eighth month of 1449
tuples.mechanism: enthroning a successor makes a captive ruler worthless as a lever

tuples.episode_object: a gate defence plan assigning units outside the walls
tuples.time_place_scope: the nine gates of Beijing, the winter of 1449
tuples.mechanism: fighting in front of the gates rather than behind them keeps a siege from starting
tuples.evidence_lens: the defence plan compared with the account of where the fighting actually occurred

tuples.episode_object: a firearms issue register for hand cannons and powder
tuples.time_place_scope: the capital arsenals, the 1450s
tuples.mechanism: issuing powder by weight ties how long a wall can fire to a storehouse ledger
tuples.evidence_lens: issue registers compared with the number of gun crews the units were meant to hold

tuples.episode_object: a returned ruler's residence order restricting visitors
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern palace compound, 1450 to 1457
tuples.mechanism: housing a former ruler under guard leaves a rival claim alive inside the same court
tuples.evidence_lens: visitor restrictions compared with the officials who later organised the restoration

tuples.episode_object: a memorial proposing walls instead of expeditions
tuples.time_place_scope: the ministry offices, the 1470s
tuples.mechanism: a fixed defence line trades a chance of decisive victory for a predictable yearly cost
tuples.evidence_lens: the projected wall cost compared with the recorded cost of one steppe campaign

tuples.episode_object: a tamped earth wall section with its construction marker
tuples.time_place_scope: the Yansui frontier in the Ordos, the 1470s and 1480s
tuples.mechanism: assigning each unit a measured length of wall makes bad work traceable to its builders
tuples.evidence_lens: marker sections matched to unit records where the wall later failed

tuples.episode_object: a military household register recording a hereditary soldier's line
tuples.time_place_scope: the Shanxi garrisons, the mid fifteenth century
tuples.mechanism: hereditary service guarantees numbers on paper while quality falls with each generation
tuples.evidence_lens: registered strength compared with the men actually present at inspection

tuples.episode_object: a desertion report listing men absent from a frontier post
tuples.time_place_scope: the Gansu corridor posts, the 1450s and 1460s
tuples.mechanism: soldiers farming assigned land to feed themselves lose the time needed to train
tuples.evidence_lens: absence reports compared with the harvest calendar of the garrison farms

tuples.episode_object: a border trade licence issued to a named merchant
tuples.time_place_scope: Hami and the oasis route, the later fifteenth century
tuples.mechanism: licensing trade at fixed posts lets a state open and close a neighbour's income at will
tuples.evidence_lens: licence numbers issued in years of quiet compared with years of raiding

tuples.episode_object: a ransom negotiation record kept by an envoy
tuples.time_place_scope: the steppe camps and the frontier gate at Xuanfu, 1450
tuples.mechanism: sending an envoy without authority to pay lets a court refuse without saying so
tuples.evidence_lens: envoy instructions compared with what the envoy actually offered on the ground

tuples.episode_object: a posthumous rehabilitation decree for an executed minister
tuples.time_place_scope: the capital courts, 1457 and after
tuples.mechanism: punishing the defenders of a siege ties later policy to who won the court struggle
tuples.evidence_lens: the charges at trial compared with the later decree that reversed them

tuples.episode_object: a stone tablet recording repairs to a garrison temple
tuples.time_place_scope: a walled town in northern Zhili, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a frontier settlement rebuilt after a raid records what the raid destroyed
tuples.evidence_lens: repair tablets counted by decade against the recorded raiding years

tuples.episode_object: a cast bronze bombard barrel with its founder's inscription
tuples.time_place_scope: the foundry at Edirne, 1452 and 1453
tuples.mechanism: casting guns near their target avoids moving barrels that no road could carry far
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving barrel weights compared with the haulage capacity described for the road east

tuples.episode_object: a limestone shot dressed to a single gauge
tuples.time_place_scope: the quarries and camp parks outside the land walls, the spring of 1453
tuples.mechanism: matching shot to one bore fixes how many rounds a heavy gun can fire in a day
tuples.evidence_lens: recovered shot diameters measured against the bores of the guns that survive

tuples.episode_object: a three-towered fortress commanding a narrow channel
tuples.time_place_scope: the European shore of the Bosphorus at Rumeli Hisari, 1452
tuples.mechanism: a gun tower on a strait turns free passage into a toll and then into a blockade
tuples.evidence_lens: the tower's field of fire measured against the channel width and the current's set

tuples.episode_object: an iron chain carried on floating booms
tuples.time_place_scope: the entrance of the Golden Horn, 1453
tuples.mechanism: a boom turns a harbour into a safe anchorage and frees defenders from its shoreline
tuples.evidence_lens: the surviving chain links measured against the width they had to span

tuples.episode_object: a rubble and brick repair patch in a curtain wall
tuples.time_place_scope: the Lycus valley stretch of the land walls, the spring of 1453
tuples.mechanism: a stockade rebuilt nightly in a breach costs fewer men than holding the ground beyond
tuples.evidence_lens: masonry phases in the repaired stretch compared with untouched sections either side

tuples.episode_object: a ship's day-by-day journal of a blockade
tuples.time_place_scope: the anchorage inside the Golden Horn, April to the end of the siege in 1453
tuples.mechanism: a diarist counting sail arrivals records how thin a relief squadron actually was
tuples.evidence_lens: the journal's ship counts compared with the departure records kept in the home port

tuples.episode_object: a notary's deed registering a merchant's property transfer
tuples.time_place_scope: the Genoese colony at Pera, the months either side of 1453
tuples.mechanism: a neutral colony's residents insure themselves by registering title with both sides
tuples.evidence_lens: deeds drawn before the fall compared with those the same notary drew afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a parchment grant with a ruler's monogram guaranteeing residents
tuples.time_place_scope: Galata across the water, the summer of 1453
tuples.mechanism: guaranteeing a trading quarter's law and taxes keeps its customs revenue from leaving
tuples.evidence_lens: the grant's clauses compared with the privileges that quarter held under the old regime

tuples.episode_object: greased timber slipways laid over a ridge
tuples.time_place_scope: the slope from the Bosphorus shore to the upper Golden Horn, 1453
tuples.mechanism: hauling light galleys overland puts warships inside a boom that cannot be forced
tuples.evidence_lens: the route's gradients measured against the recorded size of the vessels said to be moved

tuples.episode_object: a ransom receipt drawn up for a captured merchant
tuples.time_place_scope: Chios and the Aegean islands, 1453 and 1454
tuples.mechanism: a fixed ransom market turns captives into a currency that funds the next season's fleet
tuples.evidence_lens: receipt sums compared across ranks to see what a captive's status was thought worth

tuples.episode_object: a register of households, trades and taxes street by street
tuples.time_place_scope: the captured city, the survey of 1455
tuples.mechanism: counting an emptied city's households shows how much of it a conquest actually held
tuples.evidence_lens: the survey totals compared with the population the last defenders' accounts imply

tuples.episode_object: a resettlement order moving families from named Anatolian towns
tuples.time_place_scope: Anatolia and the new capital, 1459 to 1470
tuples.mechanism: compulsory resettlement refills a captured city faster than voluntary migration would
tuples.evidence_lens: the origin towns named in the orders checked against those towns' later tax registers

tuples.episode_object: an endowment deed assigning a converted building's income
tuples.time_place_scope: the central district of the new capital, the 1450s and 1460s
tuples.mechanism: an endowment fixes a building's upkeep and its use in a document outliving the ruler
tuples.evidence_lens: the deed's listed revenues compared with the same properties in the next survey

tuples.episode_object: an insurance policy priced for a voyage to the Black Sea
tuples.time_place_scope: the Rialto insurance market in Venice, 1451 to 1460
tuples.mechanism: a rising premium prices a strait's closure long before any treaty admits to it
tuples.evidence_lens: premium rates for the same route quoted before and after the strait changed hands

tuples.episode_object: a manuscript newsletter carried west by galley
tuples.time_place_scope: Rome and the Italian courts, the summer and autumn of 1453
tuples.mechanism: news travelling at ship speed arrives as rumour and hardens into policy before confirmation
tuples.evidence_lens: dated letters compared for how the reported facts changed between first and later versions

tuples.episode_object: a crusade tax assessment roll on clergy income
tuples.time_place_scope: central Europe, 1454 to 1456
tuples.mechanism: an emergency tax voted for a distant campaign mostly funds the nearest threatened frontier
tuples.evidence_lens: sums assessed compared with sums actually spent on the Danube defences

tuples.episode_object: a river fortress's powder and provision return
tuples.time_place_scope: Belgrade on the Danube, 1456
tuples.mechanism: a fortress astride a river route sets how far upstream an army can be supplied
tuples.evidence_lens: the return's stock figures compared with what a garrison of that size would consume

tuples.episode_object: a portolan chart redrawn with new flags on the straits
tuples.time_place_scope: the chartmakers of Mallorca and Genoa, the later fifteenth century
tuples.mechanism: flags on a chart tell a shipmaster whose permission each anchorage now requires
tuples.evidence_lens: successive charts of the same coast compared for which harbours change hands and when

tuples.episode_object: a tax-farm contract for a toll station on a strait
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dardanelles toll stations, the 1470s
tuples.mechanism: farming a toll to a bidder converts uncertain traffic into a fixed sum paid in advance
tuples.evidence_lens: bid prices over successive years read as a record of how traffic recovered

tuples.episode_object: a grain price series kept by a monastery steward
tuples.time_place_scope: the Aegean and Adriatic ports, 1450 to 1480
tuples.mechanism: closing a grain route raises prices at the far end before shortage becomes visible
tuples.evidence_lens: monthly price runs from several ports compared to see which felt the closure first

tuples.episode_object: a matchlock barrel carrying an Ottoman proof mark
tuples.time_place_scope: Zeila and the Gulf of Aden coast, the 1520s
tuples.mechanism: firearms bought at a Red Sea port reach a highland war through one coastal entrepot
tuples.evidence_lens: port customs notices compared with the weapons described in the campaign narrative

tuples.episode_object: a campaign narrative in Arabic written by a participant chronicler
tuples.time_place_scope: Harar and the eastern lowlands, 1529-1537
tuples.mechanism: a chronicle written for a patron records pay and supply it had no reason to invent
tuples.evidence_lens: its logistics figures checked against royal chronicles covering the same seasons

tuples.episode_object: a church treasury inventory of processional crosses and gold vessels
tuples.time_place_scope: the island monasteries of Lake Tana, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: portable treasure moved onto lake islands turns water into the last secure vault
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving inventories compared with the objects still held in the same treasuries

tuples.episode_object: an illuminated gospel book with a colophon naming a flight
tuples.time_place_scope: Tigray and its rock-hewn churches, 1531-1540
tuples.mechanism: a scribe's note added in flight dates a manuscript's removal to the week it happened
tuples.evidence_lens: colophon dates plotted on a map to trace the direction of the evacuations

tuples.episode_object: a hilltop enclosure of dry stone with a single approach
tuples.time_place_scope: the Amba Sel escarpment in Amhara, 1531
tuples.mechanism: a mobile court without a fixed capital cannot be defeated by taking any one place
tuples.evidence_lens: the recorded royal camp sites plotted year by year to test how far the court moved

tuples.episode_object: a factor's letter requesting men and powder from an ocean network
tuples.time_place_scope: Goa and Lisbon, 1535-1541
tuples.mechanism: a request routed across two oceans takes years, which sets when help can arrive
tuples.evidence_lens: letter dates compared with the sailing seasons of the monsoon that carried them

tuples.episode_object: a wheel-lock firearm and a bronze field gun landed from a ship
tuples.time_place_scope: Massawa on the Eritrean coast, 1541
tuples.mechanism: a small expedition matters only where its firearms outrange those already in the field
tuples.evidence_lens: weapon types on both sides counted from the two contemporary campaign narratives

tuples.episode_object: a captured banner sewn from imported silk
tuples.time_place_scope: the Wofla and Wayna Daga districts, 1542-1543
tuples.mechanism: the death of one commander dissolves an army held together by his personal following
tuples.evidence_lens: the two narratives compared for how each explains the collapse after he fell

tuples.episode_object: a land grant charter written into the margin of a gospel manuscript
tuples.time_place_scope: Shewa and Gojjam, the 1540s
tuples.mechanism: regranting devastated land to loyal soldiers rebuilds a tax base out of a ruined one
tuples.evidence_lens: marginal grants counted before and after the war years in the same manuscripts

tuples.episode_object: a register listing troops assigned to a garrison across a strait
tuples.time_place_scope: Zabid and the Yemeni coast, the 1530s and 1540s
tuples.mechanism: a garrison over a narrow sea supplies men without committing an empire to a campaign
tuples.evidence_lens: register strengths compared with the auxiliary numbers the chronicles report ashore

tuples.episode_object: a sale deed for captives drawn up at a coastal market
tuples.time_place_scope: the ports of the Somali coast, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: captives exported to buy weapons make each raid finance the next season's firearms
tuples.evidence_lens: sale prices compared with the recorded cost of a musket in the same market

tuples.episode_object: a salt bar cut to standard length and used as currency
tuples.time_place_scope: the Afar depression and the highland markets, 1500-1600
tuples.mechanism: pay issued in bar salt ties an army to routes where the bars are actually accepted
tuples.evidence_lens: salt bar lengths from finds measured against the values quoted in market accounts

tuples.episode_object: rebuilt roof timbers cut after a monastery burning
tuples.time_place_scope: Lalibela and the Lasta highlands, the mid sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: rebuilding recorded in timber and plaster dates a destruction better than a chronicle
tuples.evidence_lens: timber felling dates compared with the years the chronicles claim for each burning

tuples.episode_object: a credential letter carried by an embassy to a distant court
tuples.time_place_scope: Rome and the Iberian courts, 1520-1541
tuples.mechanism: an embassy seeking allies must first prove a shared faith before it is heard at all
tuples.evidence_lens: the embassy's own account compared with the curial registers recording its reception

tuples.episode_object: an iron bit and stirrups from a cavalry burial
tuples.time_place_scope: the Dawaro and Bali marches, the 1530s
tuples.mechanism: raiding cavalry can hold lowland ground but cannot garrison the escarpment above it
tuples.evidence_lens: raid routes in the narratives plotted against the elevation of each place named

tuples.episode_object: a relief distribution note kept by a monastery steward
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern highlands, the years after 1543
tuples.mechanism: a countryside stripped of seed grain stays hungry for seasons after fighting stops
tuples.evidence_lens: grain issue records compared with the sowing seasons named in the same accounts

tuples.episode_object: a mosque foundation inscription cut into dressed stone
tuples.time_place_scope: the walled town of Harar, the later sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: walling a capital after a failed expansion turns an offensive state into a defensive one
tuples.evidence_lens: the inscription's date compared with the construction phases found in the wall itself

tuples.episode_object: a genealogical list of pastoral groups copied by a court scribe
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern approaches to the plateau, from the 1550s
tuples.mechanism: two exhausted states leave a vacuum a third population moves into without a battle
tuples.evidence_lens: chronicle lists of newly named groups counted decade by decade across the century

tuples.episode_object: a sketch map of highland provinces annotated with their revenues
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ethiopian plateau, the early seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: an outsider's revenue map records which provinces never recovered their assessment
tuples.evidence_lens: the sketch's figures compared with pre-war tribute lists from the royal chronicles

tuples.episode_object: the cut-stone foundations of a permanent palace
tuples.time_place_scope: Gondar above the Tana shore, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: building a fixed capital reverses the moving-court habit that earlier survival required
tuples.evidence_lens: the palace's building date compared with the last recorded year of a moving camp

tuples.episode_object: a notarised founding document for a town created on a beach
tuples.time_place_scope: the Gulf coast at Veracruz, April 1519
tuples.mechanism: founding a municipality lets a commander draw authority from a new council, not a governor
tuples.evidence_lens: the founding instrument compared with the original licence for the voyage and its stated limits

tuples.episode_object: a tribute cloth bundle handed over to visiting strangers
tuples.time_place_scope: Cempoala in the Totonac country, mid 1519
tuples.mechanism: a town that stops tribute to a distant capital must find an armed patron the same season
tuples.evidence_lens: the recorded tribute items compared with the district's entries in surviving pictorial tribute rolls

tuples.episode_object: a painted cloth showing allied lords in negotiated seating order
tuples.time_place_scope: Tlaxcala, September 1519
tuples.mechanism: an alliance drawn as seated equals records terms the later written accounts quietly downgrade
tuples.evidence_lens: the painted seating order compared with the Castilian narrative's description of the same meeting

tuples.episode_object: a burned house floor sealed under a plaza's later pavement
tuples.time_place_scope: Cholula, October 1519
tuples.mechanism: a killing inside a walled precinct requires the gates shut first, which leaves a physical trace
tuples.evidence_lens: excavated burning and gate layers compared against the two surviving and conflicting written versions

tuples.episode_object: a treasury tally of melted gold objects weighed into bars
tuples.time_place_scope: the palace quarter of Tenochtitlan, November 1519
tuples.mechanism: melting worked objects into bars destroys their identity and makes a royal fifth easy to fix
tuples.evidence_lens: the tally weights compared with the surviving inventory descriptions of the objects before melting

tuples.episode_object: an interpreter's baptismal entry in a coastal parish book
tuples.time_place_scope: the Tabasco river mouth, March 1519
tuples.mechanism: a two-language relay lets a commander negotiate without either side checking the other's words
tuples.evidence_lens: passages where the surviving Nahuatl and Castilian accounts of one speech diverge, set side by side

tuples.episode_object: a governor's commission ordering a rival captain's arrest
tuples.time_place_scope: Cuba and the Hispaniola high court, 1518-1520
tuples.mechanism: a jurisdictional quarrel at home splits an expedition into two forces that must fight
tuples.evidence_lens: the commission text compared with the appeals lodged by both captains before the same court

tuples.episode_object: a muster list of men absorbed from a defeated relief force
tuples.time_place_scope: Cempoala and the coast road, May 1520
tuples.mechanism: beaten troops who are paid and re-enlisted turn a rival's expedition into reinforcements
tuples.evidence_lens: the muster names compared with the earlier passenger lists of the ships that carried them over

tuples.episode_object: a broken causeway span with driven piles still in the lake bed
tuples.time_place_scope: the causeways of Tenochtitlan, June and July 1520
tuples.mechanism: a raised road cut in several places forces a retreating column into water it cannot fight from
tuples.evidence_lens: surveyed causeway breaks compared with the crossing points named in the escape narratives

tuples.episode_object: a field surgeon's note listing wounds treated on a march
tuples.time_place_scope: Otumba and the road to Tlaxcala, July 1520
tuples.mechanism: a force that keeps its wounded moving depends on allied villages feeding it, not on baggage
tuples.evidence_lens: the wound list compared with the route's village names and their recorded provisioning obligations

tuples.episode_object: a branding iron used to mark captives taken in a punitive raid
tuples.time_place_scope: Tepeaca, autumn 1520
tuples.mechanism: declaring captives lawful slaves turns a campaign into an operation that finances itself
tuples.evidence_lens: branding records compared with the legal opinions issued on when captives could be enslaved

tuples.episode_object: a lake-shore ropewalk site where rigging was laid out
tuples.time_place_scope: the lake shore at Texcoco, February to April 1521
tuples.mechanism: a canal cut to launch prefabricated hulls converts a land siege into a contest for open water
tuples.evidence_lens: the surveyed launching canal's dimensions compared with the stated beam and draught of the vessels

tuples.episode_object: a carpenter's tally of hull timbers cut and numbered for transport
tuples.time_place_scope: the shipyards at Tlaxcala, the winter of 1520-1521
tuples.mechanism: numbering every timber inland lets porters carry hulls overland and rebuild them at the water
tuples.evidence_lens: the timber tally compared with the porter numbers the allied towns recorded supplying

tuples.episode_object: a chinampa plot boundary post in a southern lake town
tuples.time_place_scope: Xochimilco and the southern lake towns, April 1521
tuples.mechanism: taking the garden districts removes the island's nearest fresh vegetables before any assault

tuples.mechanism: an amalgamation process tied to one mercury source lets a state throttle silver at will

tuples.mechanism: a defeated party dictating its own account creates a document a court cannot ignore

tuples.mechanism: a tribute payable in goods rather than coin ties a peace to one year's harvest

tuples.mechanism: a walled town astride a grain route must be taken twice if the first attempt leaves it fed

tuples.mechanism: a position resupplied by river holds when the besieger's own road is a day longer

tuples.mechanism: a chain of forts holding a coast keeps a bridgehead alive through a truce without a field army

tuples.episode_object: a tally trade permit demanded as a condition of peace

tuples.mechanism: when two sides report different terms to their own courts, ratification exposes the gap
tuples.evidence_lens: the demands presented compared with what the returning envoys told their own ministry

tuples.mechanism: a tidal race lets a small squadron fight a large one in the width the channel allows

tuples.episode_object: a captured potter's household registration entry in a domain register
tuples.time_place_scope: Namwon and the Jeolla interior, 1597
tuples.mechanism: taking skilled artisans transfers an industry, so an aim is met without holding ground
tuples.evidence_lens: the domain registers of potters compared with the kiln sites starting in the same decade

tuples.mechanism: a siege in frost is decided by fuel and water rather than by walls or by assault

tuples.episode_object: a charter of religious liberties sealed by an emperor

tuples.mechanism: a grant whose scope is disputed lets each side claim it was the other who broke faith
tuples.evidence_lens: the charter's wording on who may build churches read against later petitions citing it

tuples.episode_object: a confiscation list of noble estates transferred to new owners

tuples.mechanism: seizing land from the defeated makes the winners' supporters the guarantors of the result
tuples.evidence_lens: the transfer list matched to land-tax records for the same villages twenty years on

tuples.episode_object: a lightweight coin struck from debased silver
tuples.time_place_scope: the mints of central Europe, 1621 to 1623
tuples.mechanism: paying troops in thinned coin passes the cost of war to anyone who accepts the money

tuples.episode_object: a receipt for a sum levied on a town under threat of burning

tuples.mechanism: an army that lives on levies must keep moving, because a district is only squeezed once

tuples.episode_object: a harbour boom chain drawn across a port mouth

tuples.mechanism: a besieged port still supplied by sea cannot be starved by a land army alone
tuples.evidence_lens: the siege lines surveyed against the shipping entries in the port's own toll book

tuples.episode_object: a parish burial register with a broken sequence of entries

tuples.mechanism: a register that stops mid-year marks the moment the clerk keeping it could no longer work

tuples.mechanism: princes who can withdraw contingents make a monarch's general removable by negotiation

tuples.episode_object: a contract binding a financier to raise and equip a regiment

tuples.mechanism: collecting another ruler's tolls funds an army abroad without taxing anyone at home
tuples.evidence_lens: toll receipts compared with the campaign budgets submitted to the collecting crown

tuples.episode_object: a passport issued to a refugee family leaving a war district

tuples.mechanism: papers that let people move also let authorities count who left and who never returned

tuples.mechanism: where an envoy sits encodes his ruler's rank, so procedure must be settled before terms

tuples.episode_object: a clause fixing a reference year for church property

tuples.episode_object: a schedule of troop withdrawals tied to staged cash payments

tuples.episode_object: a painted scroll of a submission audience with named attendees

tuples.episode_object: a wampum belt exchanged at a frontier treaty council

tuples.episode_object: an order book kept by a brigade major during a river campaign

tuples.mechanism: paying for a foreign garrison converts a prince's revenue into another state's army

tuples.evidence_lens: the instructions compared with the terms the envoy actually reported agreeing to

tuples.episode_object: an intercepted letter addressed to a distant governor

tuples.mechanism: a published overture supplies the legal pretext an ultimatum is later built on

tuples.mechanism: a survey made after a conquest turns settlement terms into collectable assessments

tuples.mechanism: a monopoly on an export crop pays for the garrisons that keep a district quiet
tuples.evidence_lens: the monopoly's returns compared with earlier private trade figures for the same goods

tuples.mechanism: an armoury inventory shows what a state could make itself and what it had to buy
tuples.evidence_lens: the marked barrels compared with imported patterns of the same date in that store

tuples.episode_object: a campaign medal struck for issue by rank

tuples.mechanism: a medal issued by rank creates an official roll of who is agreed to have been present

tuples.episode_object: a restoration instrument seating a boy raja under a resident

tuples.mechanism: one failure producing a general doctrine for future mandates
